"All incidents created  between "&[Min Date for Incidents]&"- "&[Max Date for Incidents]
&", count all sessions completed between "&FORMAT([Min Date],"YYYYMM")&"- "&FORMAT([Max Date],"YYYYMM") & "."

measures.name: Min Date for Incidents
measures.expression:
VAR _Sliding =

    TRIM ( [Selected Sliding Window] )

VAR min_date =

    IF (        _Sliding = "YTD",

        STARTOFYEAR ( 'Incurred Month'[Incurred Month Begin Dt] ),

        IF (            _Sliding = "15",

            EDATE (MIN ( 'Incurred Month'[Incurred Month Begin Dt] ),

                1 - VALUE ( _Sliding )),

            EDATE (MIN ( 'Incurred Month'[Incurred Month Begin Dt] ),

                1 - VALUE ( [Selected Sliding Window] ))))VAR max_date =

    IF (        _Sliding = "15",

        EDATE ( MAX ( 'Incurred Month'[Incurred Month Begin Dt] ), -3 ),

        MAX ( 'Incurred Month'[Incurred Month Begin Dt] ))
        RETURN Format(min_date,"YYYYMM")

measures.name: Max Date for Incidents
measures.expression:
VAR _Sliding =
    TRIM ( [Selected Sliding Window] )
Var Max_date = IF (
        _Sliding = "15",
        EDATE ( MAX ( 'Incurred Month'[Incurred Month Begin Dt]), -3 ),
        MAX ( 'Incurred Month'[Incurred Month Begin Dt]))
        return
FORMAT(Max_date,"YYYYMM")

measures.name: Min Date
measures.expression:
VAR _Sliding =
    TRIM ( [Selected Sliding Window] )
VAR min_date =
    IF (
        _Sliding = "YTD",
        STARTOFYEAR ( 'FACT_INCDNT_SESN'[Session Created Date] ),
        IF (
            _Sliding = "15",
            EDATE (
                MIN ( 'FACT_INCDNT_SESN'[Session Created Date] ),
                1 - VALUE ( _Sliding )
            ),
            EDATE (
                MIN ( 'FACT_INCDNT_SESN'[Session Created Date] ),
                1 - VALUE ( [Selected Sliding Window] )
            )
        )
    )
Return 
min_date

measures.name: Max Date
measures.expression:
VAR _Sliding =
    TRIM ( [Selected Sliding Window] )
VAR max_date =
    IF (
        _Sliding = "15",
        EDATE ( MAX ( FACT_INCDNT_SESN[Session Created Date] ), -3 ),
        MAX ( FACT_INCDNT_SESN[Session Created Date] ))
Return 
max_date
